description.narrative: The Amazon Fund is a REDD+ mechanism managed by BNDES to support efforts to prevent, monitor and combat deforestation, as well as to promote preservation and sustainable development in the Brazilian Amazon. The Amazon Fund’s assets come from donations and net returns from financial investments, which are then invested by BNDES into projects in the Brazilian Amazon. The Amazon Rainforest is of vital importance to the planet, both in terms of climate and biodiversity. It is home to millions of species of flora and fauna (many of which are unique to the region) and acts as one of the largest carbon sinks, critical in mitigating the effects of the climate crisis. The Amazon is also home to over a million Indigenous Peoples, comprised of hundreds of different ethnic groups, and is of indispensable cultural and economic importance to these communities.
